title: Contains Duplicate
summary: Report whether any value appears more than once in an array.
statement:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **at least twice**, and `false`
if every element is distinct.
hints: What data structure answers 'have I seen this before?' in constant time?
Add values to a HashSet as you scan. Set.add returns false when the value is already there.

seen = empty set
for n in nums:
    if not seen.add(n): return true
return false

Comparing every pair is O(n^2). Sorting first and checking neighbours is O(n log n) time and O(1) extra space (if you may modify the input), which is a valid trade-off to mention. A HashSet gives O(n) average time and O(n) space, and it can stop as soon as it finds the first duplicate.
